name: PM-KISAN
description: Income support for landholding farmer families, paid directly to the bank account.
benefit: Rs 6,000 per year in three instalments of Rs 2,000.
howToApply: Register on the PM-KISAN portal or at a Common Service Centre. Keep your land record and bank passbook ready. Check your status on the portal afterwards.
documents: Land ownership record,Bank passbook (account in your name),Mobile number linked to your bank account,Identity proof
eligibility: Landholding farmer families. Some groups are excluded, for example income-tax payers and holders of high constitutional posts.
rulesNote: Screening is by occupation and land ownership. Official exclusion rules apply on the portal.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
description: Cashless hospital treatment cover for eligible poor and vulnerable families.
benefit: Health cover of up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year at empanelled hospitals.
howToApply: Check if you are listed on the official portal or at a Common Service Centre or empanelled hospital help desk. Eligible people get an Ayushman card.
documents: Identity proof,Family or ration card,Mobile number
eligibility: Families are identified from official deprivation and occupation lists, not by a single income number.
rulesNote: Our income check is only a screening proxy. The official beneficiary list decides.

name: Ayushman Vay Vandana (age 70+)
description: Health cover for senior citizens under PM-JAY.
benefit: Health cover for people aged 70 and above under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY.
howToApply: Apply through the Ayushman Bharat portal or app, or at a Common Service Centre.
eligibility: Senior citizens aged 70 years and above. Confirm current coverage details on the official site.

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
description: One portal for many central and state scholarships for students.
benefit: Scholarship amounts depend on the scheme, course and category.
howToApply: Create an account on the National Scholarship Portal, pick the scholarships you qualify for, fill the form and upload documents. Your institution then verifies it.
documents: Income certificate,Caste certificate (if applicable),Previous year marksheet,Bank passbook,Admission or fee receipt
eligibility: Students who meet the rules of a particular scholarship. Income limits and categories differ by scholarship.
rulesNote: Income limit shown is a common one; each scholarship sets its own.
deadline: Each scholarship has its own window, usually once a year

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
description: LPG connection for women from poor households.
benefit: Free LPG connection and support on refills for eligible households.
howToApply: Apply at your nearest LPG distributor or through the official portal with a filled KYC form.
documents: Ration card or proof of household status,Identity proof of the woman applicant,Bank passbook,Passport-size photo
eligibility: Adult women from eligible poor households who do not already have an LPG connection.
rulesNote: Income limit is a screening proxy. Household category rules apply officially.

name: PM Awas Yojana - Gramin
description: Help to build a pucca house for eligible rural families.
benefit: Financial assistance for building a house, plus support under linked schemes.
howToApply: Contact your Gram Panchayat or block office. Selection is from the official beneficiary list.
documents: Identity proof,Bank passbook,Job card (if available),Proof of residence
eligibility: Eligible rural households without a pucca house, selected from official lists.
rulesNote: Income limit is a screening proxy. The official list decides.

name: PM Awas Yojana - Urban
description: Home ownership support for urban families in lower and middle income groups.
benefit: Assistance towards buying, building or improving a home.
howToApply: Apply on the official PMAY-Urban portal or through your Urban Local Body or a bank.
documents: Identity proof,Income proof or certificate,Bank passbook,Proof of residence
eligibility: Urban households within the scheme's income groups who do not own a pucca house.
rulesNote: Income ceiling used here is the top income group; the exact group sets the benefit.

name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
description: Low-cost life insurance through your bank account.
benefit: Life cover of Rs 2 lakh for a small yearly premium (about Rs 436).
howToApply: Ask your bank branch or use net banking to enrol. The premium is auto-debited each year.

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana
description: Accident insurance through your bank account.
benefit: Rs 2 lakh cover for accidental death or full disability, premium about Rs 20 a year.
howToApply: Ask your bank branch or use net banking to enrol. The premium is auto-debited each year.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: A guaranteed monthly pension after age 60 for people in the unorganised sector.
benefit: Pension of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 per month after 60, depending on what you contribute.
howToApply: Open the account at your bank or post office and choose your pension amount. Contributions are auto-debited.
documents: Bank or post office savings account,Identity proof,Mobile number
eligibility: Citizens aged 18 to 40 with a savings account. Income-tax payers are not eligible.
rulesNote: Age is the screening rule. Income-tax status is not checked here.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (NSAP)
description: Monthly pension for poor senior citizens. Many states add to the central amount.
benefit: Monthly pension paid to your bank account. Amount differs by age and state.
howToApply: Apply at your Gram Panchayat, municipality or the state social welfare office.
documents: Proof of age,BPL or household status proof,Bank passbook,Identity proof,Passport-size photo
eligibility: Senior citizens aged 60 and above from poor households.
rulesNote: Income limit is a screening proxy. States set BPL rules.

name: PM SVANidhi (street vendors)
description: Easy working-capital loans for street vendors.
benefit: Collateral-free loan starting at Rs 10,000, with larger loans after timely repayment.
howToApply: Apply on the official portal or at a Common Service Centre or Urban Local Body with your vending proof.
documents: Vending certificate or letter of recommendation,Identity proof,Bank account
eligibility: Street vendors working in urban areas, with a vending certificate or recommendation letter.
rulesNote: Occupation and area are the screening rules.

name: MGNREGA
description: A legal right to wage work for rural households.
benefit: Up to 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per rural household per year.
howToApply: Apply for a job card at your Gram Panchayat, then ask in writing for work.
documents: Identity proof,Passport-size photo,Bank or post office account,Proof of residence
eligibility: Adult members of rural households willing to do unskilled manual work.
rulesNote: Age and area are the screening rules.

name: PM Vishwakarma
description: Recognition, training, tools and credit for traditional artisans and craftspeople.
benefit: Skill training with a stipend, a toolkit incentive and collateral-free credit.
howToApply: Register at a Common Service Centre or on the official portal. Your local body verifies your trade.
documents: Identity proof,Bank account,Mobile number,Proof of trade (as asked)
eligibility: Artisans and craftspeople in listed traditional trades, aged 18 or above.
rulesNote: Occupation and age are the screening rules. The trade must be on the official list.

name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana
description: Cash support for pregnant and nursing mothers for the first living child.
benefit: Cash benefit paid in instalments to the mother's bank account.
howToApply: Register at your Anganwadi centre or health facility with your pregnancy and bank details.
documents: Mother and Child Protection card,Identity proof,Bank passbook,Proof of pregnancy registration
eligibility: Pregnant and lactating women aged 19 and above, for the first living child.
rulesNote: Age and gender are the screening rules. First-child status is checked at registration.
deadline: Register within the time stated at the Anganwadi

name: PM MUDRA Yojana
description: Collateral-free loans for small businesses and traders.
benefit: Loans up to Rs 10 lakh for small and micro business needs.
howToApply: Apply at any bank, NBFC or microfinance institution with a simple business plan.
documents: Identity proof,Address proof,Business proof or plan,Bank statements,Passport-size photo
eligibility: Non-farm small business owners and traders needing credit.

name: UDID - Unique Disability ID
description: One national ID that makes it easier to claim disability benefits.
benefit: A disability card accepted for many schemes, concessions and pensions.
howToApply: Apply on the official UDID portal and attend a medical assessment as directed.
documents: Identity proof,Address proof,Passport-size photo,Disability medical documents (if any)
eligibility: Persons with disabilities recognised under the law.
rulesNote: Disability status is the screening rule. A medical authority certifies it.
